notes.title: Ashes of Ur-Enku Expansion!
notes.content:
[h1]Version 3.0 - Ashes of Ur-Enku[/h1]
[h2]NEW SEASON BEGINS[/h2]
[list]
[*] 50 brand-new cards (12 per faction) now available in Ashes of Ur-Enku booster packs
[*] Previous level is saved (not yet viewable)
[/list]
[h2]BALANCE CHANGES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gunhaunt: Desperados now summoned with ATK = ½ mana cost
[*] Mastercraft Flesh Golem: Prepare → Aftermath
[*] Molten Martyr: Separated abilities - Activate: Sacrifice this creature. Sacrificed: Deal 4 damage to all players.
[*] Echoes of Verenthil: Now creates base cantrip copies
[*] Dutiful Servant: +0/+2 → +0/+1
[*] Bone Brute: 2/3 → 2/2
[*] Corpse Retrieval: 2 mana - Fetch 1 (Undead). Otherwise: Give enemy creature "Last Word: Shift to opponent’s Graveyard"
[*] Aaisha, Embalmed Servant: Banish 2 random spells from Graveyard. Summon cadaver with HP = ½ total cost + 1
[*] Worshiper of Verenthil: Now kills highest attack, not highest health
[*] Unshackle: Mobilize a creature from Reserves for mana cost
[*] Trapjaw Stump and Wyrmling Token: 1/1 → 1/2
[*] Wings of Fury renamed to Chained No More, no longer restricted to only flight creatures
[*] Bighorn Packbeast and Sludge Defender: Gained Unyielding
[*] Overwhelming Magi: 7/7 → 3/10; No extra mana gained on Reserve. Mobilized: +2/+0, Last Word moved to Entrance
[*] Nocturnal Nemesis: 7/4 → 4/7; Entrance can now mark any creature; Last Word no longer random
[*] Gurm, Former Taskmaster: 3/5 - Mobilized: Deal X damage (X = ATK). Activate: Give another +2/-2
[*] Gelatinize: Now also gives +2/+2 to Mobilized creature
[*] Serrated Stalker: 4/5 → 4/4; Last Word no longer requires Outnumbered
[*] Energized Elemental: Amped returns, 4/2 → 3/2; Mobilized: +1/+0. Last Word: Deal 1 damage
[*] Lavoraad Whelp: 3/3 → 4/3; ability can now target anything
[*] Vengeful Empath: 1/2 → 1/3; Enraged → Enraged (Innate)
[*] Avian Murder: 2/3 → 1/3; After dealing direct damage: Add Doomed copy to hand. Devotion: Unexhaust on summon
[*] Jagir Copymage: Can't copy other Jagir Copymages
[*] Meager Misdeed and Forbidden Lotus: Now only shift Innate cards
[*] Mercenary Mayhem: Enhance cost 1 → 2
[*] Poison Bomb: Already Poisoned creatures lose 2 HP. Others become Poisoned. Enhance (3): Affects enemies only
[*] Fireball: Deal X to target, 1/3 to adjacent. Enhance (1): Deal half instead
[*] Covert Contractor: Loophole removed; now DMG = Health. Devotion: Enrage (Innate): +0/+2
[*] Retaliation: No longer Doomed
[*] Improvised Laws: -2/-2 instead of -3/-3 and only until next turn
[*] Copyright Infringement: 4 mana - Summon a copy of friendly non-Legendary ≤ cost. Discarded: Shuffle all decks
[*] Violent Repossession: 6 mana - now draws a card if target < mana spent
[*] Kira, Heroine of Garsang: Gains Loophole
[*] Parchment Barrage: Condition: Opponent drew more than 2 cards this turn. Draw 3, end contract
[*] Power of Garsang: Condition: You don’t outnumber opponent. Aftermath: Allies gain +0/+1
[*] Wounded Guardian: After losing Life: Give random friendly +0/+1
[*] Perpetual Watchman: Gains Multiblocker and Restless - Blocking: Loophole allies gain +0/+1
[*] Dark Omen Spy-Hawk: 0/6 → 0/5
[*] Forceful Acquisition: Target becomes Underling
[*] Systemic Subjugation: 3 damage split between 2. Devotion = 6 damage
[*] Suppressor of Magic: Activate: Suppress a creature. Discarded: Suppress lowest ATK enemy
[*] Missionary Vanguard: 1/3 → 3/3
[*] Sunburnt Monk: Attacking: Gain +2/+0
[*] Avatar of Peace: Now Pacifies only one creature (any, not just enemy)
[*] Council Man Lazar: Entrance: Crusaders not in play gain +1/+0. Last Word: Crusaders not in play gain +0/+1
[/list]
[h2]NEW ADDITIONS & FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated Game Logo
[*] Maeve is behind the bar in the Tavern
[*] Can now return to Private Room directly from Lair and Grove
[*] All cards now have flavor text
[*] Some cards have new dynamic variables (Ex: Consequence of Chaos & Golden Gambit)
[*] New Diamond Animated Cards with drop chance from Packs, Daily Rewards, and Season Pass
[*] Golden and Diamond Animated creature bases updated
[*] Discord account linking now live - unlock exclusive tankard
[*] New Orc and Devil player races
[*] 3 new Outfits with Premium Variants entering rotating shop
[/list]
[h2]UPDATES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Original Axes have been removed from store (If you already own, you can still use them)
[*] Simplified card text using new keywords (Poison, Stun, Wounded, etc.)
[*] Increased Ranked Gold payouts (retroactively applies to ending season)
[*] Updated Game Credits
[*] Updated Tavern Prefixes
[*] Updated Fan Art in Tavern
[*] Updated Documentation and Guidebook
[/list]
[h2]FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Equilibrium not changing creature ownership when moving to Reserves
[*] Adept Gunsmith unable to mark Suppressed creatures
[*] Skill Siphoner copying lost traits
[*] Misplay protection missing for Altering Fate, Garenan, and Meager Misdeed
[*] Referral system bug blocking referrals
[*] Referral card back animation fixed for all platforms
[*] Suppressed creatures losing status visuals
[*] Switching out and back into game unmutes blocked players
[*] Further networking improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Version 2.4 Release Notes
notes.content:
IMPORTANT NOTICE
If you own the Patron of the Old Gods, make sure to log in monthly to claim your Gems.

BALANCE CHANGES
(Missed from the previous update) Tombstone Mimic now costs 5 Mana and has stats of 3/4.
Indentured Servitude no longer has the Discarded ability.
Lowly Lieutenant is now classified as an Underling and no longer has the Discarded ability.
Grand Tutoring now costs 9 Mana.
Sell-Sword no longer has the Loophole ability. Its Last Word effect is now: "ALL players gain 1 Life."

ADDED
Dante now assists new and existing players who created their accounts after December 1st, 2024, introducing mechanics that players may not have encountered before.

UPDATES
Dante has been polished with new facial features and repositioning to better suit VR players during tutorials.
Slick Grifter and Something Wicked Approaches had their text updated for consistency with other cards.
Trapjaw Stump and Hungry Mimic now include "When blocked" in their descriptions for uniformity.
Unlawful Trespass has been raised from Common to Rare.
Mystic Envisioner has been reduced from Uncommon to Common.

FIXES
The Guidebook now correctly displays milestone limits as 100 instead of 50.
A typo in the quest "Kill 5 creatures with damaging spells" has been corrected.
Masters no longer trigger "deals direct damage" abilities like Messenger Raven when taking damage.
Masters taking damage no longer incorrectly increment the Reduce your opponent’s Life Total quest.
Players will no longer draw cards if a game is forfeited during the "first person" or "redraw" steps.
The Summon Mastery Creatures quest now correctly increments for creatures granted Mastery.
The Summon Taunt Creatures quest now accounts for copies of creatures granted Taunt.
Creatures summoned by Grand Tutoring with Summon Copy abilities now correctly apply stat changes.
Copies of Amped creatures that lose the Amped status (via suppression or theft) will no longer be summoned Unexhausted.
Cunning Snaremaster’s first ability now correctly increases the damage of all Banes, not just opponents'.
Visual artifacts in Flatscreen BattleCam caused by creatures being removed too early have been resolved.
Flatscreen players no longer encounter errors when performing gestures or swapping havens.
The watch menu’s Havens page now correctly displays as Havens, not Taverns.
On Android, cards in hand will no longer become unplayable after swapping apps.
VR players now receive proper error messaging when attempting to block Flight or Loophole creatures.
Tombstone Mimic no longer exhausts itself when copying Amped creatures.
Skill Siphoner now only copies active attributes from its target, ignoring disabled or suppressed ones.
A missing tooltip explaining why a creature could not block another (if eligible to block something else) has been added.
Exiting a ranked battle now transitions background music without errors.

notes.title: Version 2.3.2 Release Notes
notes.content:
IMPORTANT NOTICE:
Hardware requirements for Cards & Tankards on Android devices have been changed, now requiring 4+ GB Ram and Android 11 or newer. Download today on the Google Play Store!
You will now need to log-in monthly if you have Patron of the Old Gods to receive your Gems.

BALANCE CHANGES:
Field Bureaucrat no longer has a Discarded ability, and reduces the cost of the first spell it sees each turn.
Alkar, the Former Master is now 10 Mana with Mastery 2, and causes you to lose 1 Life for each spell you play.
Kira, Heroine of Garsang no longer raises her own health.
Mastercraft Flesh Golem is now 9 Mana 2/12.
Dreaded Corpse Flinger lowered from 3/3 to 2/3
Forbidden Lotus’s Enhance is now "To their Banish Zone instead for 3 Coins."
Mind Squander is now 2 Mana and no longer gives life.
Bone Amalgamates no longer give health as part of their Last Word.
Soul Extraction no longer draws a card if it gets a kill.
Cosmic Reanimation now causes all players to summon the top 3 creatures of their Graveyard, dooming them and making them Undead.
Torch Carrier’s Last Word now instead Shifts all Powder Kegs in all decks to the top.
Something Wicked Approaches + Grand Tutoring now only Fetch Non-Legendaries.
Wraith’s Wrath is reduced back to 5 damage.

ADDED:
A brand new Guide Book for providing information about aspects of the game, found in your Watch Menu at the top-right.
A completely re-done and shortened tutorial.
Automatic forfeiting if a player AFKs in ranked.
A new visual showing the game deciding which player gets the first turn.
Whilst deciding which player begins, faction banner flags matching the deck’s primary and secondary choices.
Brand new "Mana Fragment" system. The player going second will gain 1 at the beginning of the game.
Tooltips for when you attempt to block and are unable to do so along with why.
A large number of new quests – Augur-focused, gamemode-focused and attribute focused.

UPDATED:
All existing quests have had a overhaul to make them better to complete
Milestone Quests have been adjusted to allow greater rewards for more consecutive quest completion.
All summons not played directly from the hand are always summoned on the right side of the board.
Patron of the Old Gods subscription page now has a "Manage Subscription" button on Android.
Flatscreen players are now able to use spells by just dragging them like they would a creature.
A minor visual change to boost visibility when the quest board has rewards ready to be claimed.

FIXED:
Mystic Envisioner’s ability being triggered by Masters.
Flatscreen Battle Camera getting pieces stuck on-screen.
Flatscreen Zones screen can get stuck with no way to close it.
Flatscreen Redraw screen getting stuck with no way for you to click on it.
A visual issue where a Flatscreen player moving a card will make it appear to be clipping in their hand to others.
Endless Enforcers summoning copies even if it’s already died (in the instance of Multi-damaging abilities).
Channeled Destruction continues to activate even though its counter is 0.
Grow the Horde keeps waiting for you to make a second selection, even if you have no room.
Creatures with passives not updating after a spell has been played.

notes.title: 1.2 Update: New Banish Synergy
notes.content:
Hey Adventurers and Patrons!

Our next set of ||spoilers|| are from the [b]Dungeon Master Faction[/b]. This Mini-Expansion has been about filling spaces in Factions lacking in some way or needing help that simple card adjustments would not cover. Dungeon Master is not one of those factions. As one of, if not the most well-rounded Factions in the game, it proved challenging to make meaningful changes to existing decks.

So, we took a different direction and introduced something completely new. 
[h2][b]Banish Deck [/b][/h2]

Banish has always been the most permanent form of removal in the game, completely removing cards from the game. But what if there was one that just would not go away? Flipping the concept of Banish as a tool on its head, these new/reworked cards should add another tool to the tool belt of Dungeon Master.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39919787/0db25ed35accc07a78209632801303face108f8a.png[/img]

[h1]Banish Deck Synergy[/h1]
[h3][i][b]All outlined rebalances are subject to change before release. Nothing listed is final.[/b][/i][/h3]

[h2][b][u]Gunhaunt’s Call[/u][/b][/h2]
[i]The initial design of Gunhant’s Call was intended to give decks, not including its namesake Gunhaunt, a way to generate Desperados and give players a way to use leftover Mana. While it did this, it was overall unused in the game due to Desperados only having one health and a lack of overall synergies outside Gunhaunt. With this established, a clean slate was made, and with the addition of the concept of a Banish deck coming up, this new direction was taken. Inside a Banish deck, this is a significant tool for cycling Eternal Aetherite and gaining value from the stat loss. Outside, it’s a valuable tool to take care of enemy units that could have been harder to deal with using existing removal tools.[/i]

[h3][b]Old:[/b][/h3]
0 Mana Spell. Spend all your Mana. Summon a Desperado with attack equal to mana spent

[h3][b]New:[/b][/h3]
1 Mana Spell.  Banish a friendly creature, then deal that creature’s attack to an enemy creature

[h2][u][b]Eternal Aetherite[/b][/u][/h2]
[i]This is the heart and soul of the new deck type. This new Elemental proves formidable as it refuses to stay gone. Its ability to navigate the Aether sees it coming back time and time again, bigger and better. Mix this with the new Banish tools and those in the game to get the most benefit. Just ensure you don’t commit too much to looping Eternal Aetherite, or you will find yourself out of cards.[/i]

[h3][b]New:[/b][/h3]
5 Mana 2 Attack 2 Health Creature. When banished from any zone, this gains +2/+2 and is placed on top of its owner’s Deck.

[h2][u][b]Mind Squander[/b][/u][/h2]
[i]From a glance, this could look like a strange card. “Banish my hand for 5 cards and 5 health? Seems crazy!” At first glance, you would be correct. Banishing your entire hand would be a foolish choice in most cases. However, with the addition of Eternal Aetherite, this becomes another part of the Banish synergy that doesn’t leave you down a card. Outside that combo, smart players will be able to get great use out of Mind Squander as a tool for getting back into the game or get rid of some cards you don’t want for those you do.[/i]

[h3][b]New:[/b][/h3]

notes.title: 1.2 Reworks : Assassin's Strike
notes.content:
Hey Adventurers and Patrons!

We have a new update coming soon, so we wanted to start sharing some of the new and updated cards coming in patch 1.2!

The first set of cards we want to share will address a deck type that you have all been asking for changes to for YEARS: [b]Assassin's Strike[/b]. While a very different and fun way to get a win, it's also survived as one of the most difficult. Assassin's Strikes have been consistently hard to get into your opponent's deck, and once there, seem to always languish out of reach. These changes are aimed at addressing this while also setting the stage for some creative space in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39919787/14e3782bb0567fb67588d2f98d94083458dc8261.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39919787/f46e8c8cb8821384cf9759095f003635879f9d45.png[/img]

[h1][b]Assassin's Strike Rebalance[/b][/h1]
[i][b]All outlined rebalances are subject to change before release. Nothing listed is final.[/b][/i]

[h2][u][b]Wanted Notice[/b][/u][/h2]

[i]While in theory, Wanted Notice has the highest cap to how many Assassin's Strikes it can place in a deck. In practice, it became one of the worst options. Since so many other cards have Enhance abilities that you must use to stay in the game long enough to make your Assassin's Strikes work, losing all of your coins was too expensive. This change aims to make Wanted Notice one of the most reliable and best-valued ways to pump Assassin's Strikes into your opponent's deck in bulk, turning this ugly duckling into the bell of the ball for Assassin's Strike.[/i]

[h3][b]Old: [/b][/h3]
Gain a coin. Randomly place an Assassin's Strike in your opponent’s deck for each coin you have. Lose all your coins. 

[h3][b]New:[/b][/h3]
Randomly place 3 Assassin's Strikes in your opponent's deck. [u]Enhance[/u]: Randomly place 6 instead for 2 coins.

[h2][u][b]Spymaster of the Guild[/b][/u][/h2]

*Spymaster was always intended to be the champion of Assassin's Strikes, and we plan to keep it that way. With Wanted Notice becoming a large influx of Assassin's Strike for your opponent to deal with, it left Spymaster feeling a bit left out. This change aims to make Spymaster less of a "drop and bounce" and more of a unit you want to keep on board. The longer Spymaster is alive, the more Assassin Strikes will build, dealing more damage and making Spymaster much more threatening than before.*

[h3][b]Old:[/b][/h3]
[u]Entrance[/u]: Randomly place 5 Assassin's Strikes into your opponent's deck. [u]Enhance[/u]: Gain "Assassin's Strike deals +1 damage." for 2 coins

[h3][b]New:[/b][/h3]
Banes deals +1 damage. [u]Prepare[/u]: Randomly place an Assassin's Strike into your opponent's deck for each Bane your opponent drew last turn.

[h2][u][b]Garngian Cutthroat[/b][/u][/h2]

[i]Garngian Cutthroat needed little in the way of changes. The effect of getting an Assassin's Strike when it died was valuable outside Assassin's Strike and the enhance just made it that much better inside. Increasing the number of Assassin's Strikes it would provide per Last Word or Deathblow when enhanced should allow it to stay in pace with the rest of the squad with this update.[/i]

[h3][b]Old:[/b][/h3]
[u]Last Word[/u]: Randomly place [b]an[/b] Assassin's Strike into your opponent's deck [u]Enhance[/u]: [u]Last Word[/u]/[u]Deathblow[/u] instead for 1 coin

[h3][b]New:[/b][/h3]
[u]Last Word[/u]: Randomly place [b]3[/b] Assassin's Strike into your opponent's deck [u]Enhance[/u]: [u]Last Word[/u]/[u]Deathblow[/u] instead for 1 coin

[h2][u][b]Passanian Liquidator[/b][/u][/h2]

[i]Passanian Liquidator has been the king of Assassin's Strike since it's inception and will likely continue to be a powerhouse in the deck after these changes. As with Cutthroat, Liquidator needed little in the way of changes outside increasing it's effectiveness to keep up with the new pace of Assassin's Strikes[/i]

[h3][b]Old:[/b][/h3]
When you take direct damage, randomly place an Assassin's Strike into your opponent's deck. [u]Enhance[/u]: Randomly place [b]2[/b] instead for [b]3[/b] coins.

[h3][b]New:[/b][/h3]
When you take direct damage, randomly place an Assassin's Strike into your opponent's deck. [u]Enhance[/u]: Randomly place [b]3[/b] instead for [b]2[/b] coins.

[h2][u][b]Assassin's Strike[/b][/u][/h2]

[i]The center of the Assassin's Strike decks is seeing no changes to the numbers or effect. The feeling and effectiveness of your opponent drawing into that dagger has always been satisfying, so there is no need to fix what it's broken. Instead, Assassin's Strikes will be the first in a new card type called "[b]Bane Spells[/b]." These spells activate a negative effect when drawn. The addition of this new sub-type will widen the space the team has to play with these cards, as seen in the new cards in the Assassin's Strike tool bag.[/i]

[h3][b]Old:[/b][/h3]
Card Type: Spell

[h3][b]New:[/b][/h3]
Card Type: [b]Bane[/b] Spell

[h2][u][b]Meager Misdeed[/b][/u][/h2]

[i]The first of the new cards is pulling double duty. Meager Misdeed acts as a form of mill for anyone looking to disrupt their opponent's plans or just shrink their deck down a bit, but when Enhanced, it clears out any non-Bane cards that may be in the way of that next tick of damage. Did your opponent just set up a pair of Endless Merc Bands for the next turn? Not any more. Been a few turns since they drew into an Assassin's Strike? Speed that up. This card brings value to just about any deck it finds it's way into.[/i]

[h3][b]New:[/b][/h3]
3 Mana Spell. 
Your opponent discards the top 2 cards from their deck. [u]Enhance[/u]: Top 2 Innate cards instead for 1 coin.

[h2][u][b]Cunning Snaremaster[/b][/u][/h2]

[i]Cunning Snaremaster is about getting your Bane Spells closer to the top of your opponent's deck to mess up that next draw. With each Activate, your opponent is closer and closer to pulling an Assassin's Strike. Pair this with the new Spymaster and you can more rapidly get to those major damage combos. But be careful, in the mirror match, this card does put you closer to damage as well.[/i]

[h3][b]New:[/b][/h3]
3 Mana 1 Attack 4 Health Creature. 
[u]Activate[/u]: All Bane Spells move up 1 position in all decks for 1 coin. [u]Enhance[/u]: 2 positions instead for 1 coin.

As you can see, Assassin's Strike will be a formidable deck type with these changes. With Wanted Notice getting you rolling early, Spymaster boosting the strength and quantity of Assassin's Strikes, Cutthroat and Liquidator being as strong as they have been, along with Snaremaster and Meager Misdeed helping get those Assassin's Strikes closer to the top, you will have players questioning every card draw.

notes.title: Version 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Adventurers and Patrons!

We strive to give as many players as possible the best experience possible, but after months of implementation, it was clear that Age Restricted Taverns was not having the desired result of allowing players to have the experience they expect. Due to this, we are moving to a Reputation Based Tavern system. 

The concept is that as long as you are on and behaving, you will gain reputation and gain access to taverns with like-minded individuals. We expect this will improve all player's experiences as the system runs and you should all have a better time on average.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39919787/56bd97805b5a8bfa520b01cc82393209b4edb182.png[/img]

Additionally, we have added Draft Mode to the Tavern! Show your skill and select 40 cards at random to battle it out over 10 matches for increasingly better rewards! Will you conquer the map left by Maeve and claim the top prize?

Lastly, the Taunt keyword has been updated:

[i]A creature with Taunt must be blocked or targeted by the enemy first each turn.[/i]

This change has been made to give a counter-play to targeted damage and removal spells. Mastery has run the show for some time now and it is due in part to it's ability to ignore your creatures. This update will require Mastery players to first get rid of your taunt unit's effect in order to damage you directly. This change will improve Taunt's usability in the meta as well as tone down the rampant use of Mastery.

All in, this is a big update! If you want more details, as well as a few things I didn't cover here, check out the rest of the notes below:

notes.title: The Plundering Guild
notes.content:
The focus of this update was adding a new faction, the Plundering Guild. This update adds 35 new cards for you to collect! The Plundering Guild has a resource called coins that you use to enhance cards to improve their stats and abilities. To enhance a card, grab it and tap it to the spinning coin on the table during a battle.

notes.title: Progression Rewards and Outfits
notes.content:
The main focus of this update was adding the progression rewards system. There is a free tier which rewards you Gold, Gems, Random Cards, and Booster Packs when you level up. Experience Points (XP) are earned from battles and quests.

A Gem tier rewards you a bundle of cosmetics at a great value as you level up. Level 95 and 100 of the Gem tier reward the Founder's Deck Box and Animated Card Back which are exclusive to this season. All other cosmetics from the Gem tier will be available for gold the following season.

Our current projection is that seasons will last around 4 months and will launch alongside an expansion of new cards. This first "Founder" season while we are in early access does not have a projected end date and will be used to collect critical player feedback.

[b]What we are working on next:[/b]
Next up we will be working on a new faction of cards, the Plundering Guild! We intend to release this entire faction in a single update for you all, so our next update will take longer to get out than usual. We are shooting for a development time-frame of two months, but this is of course subject to change. Stay tuned and keep an eye on our twitter account for teasers as we get closer to the faction's release date!
